items.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]
items.q: I always wanted to meet Bill Challis who wrote the orchestration for the Goldkettes and later for Paul Whiteman.

ctx.x: This is something entirely different. I always wanted to meet Bill Challis who wrote the orchestration for the Goldkettes and later for Paul Whiteman. And he had his 75th birthday party and here’s a picture. A handsome guy when he was young.
